content:
From no-
thing
we have ri-
sen
And from no-
thing
we still
[C5]rise
Take your life back
Fight,
fight
Will you fight
to take your life back?

[Verse 1]
[C5]Ask yourself what's
truly yours in life
Are you in control
or someone's slave?
All that you cherish,
all that you love In the
blink of an eye can be
taken from you
In moments of tra-
gedy we bond
And in weakness
clarity thrives
I've been blessed with the
inspiration
To take what little I have
and always

[Bridge]
[Gb5]strive

[Verse 2]
[Gb5]Sometimes survi-
ving is
all that you can do
I never claimed
to have
All the answers
or the solutions
My satisfac-
tion is knowing, That
my desires will
not be killed
With a readiness
to defend
What is mine and ne-
ver compromise

[Chorus]
[C5]  [G5]  [Bb5]
The [F5]foundation [Eb5]of our
[C5]lives [G5][Bb5]Built
on [F5]hollow [Eb5]ground
[C5][G5]We must [Bb5]un-
learn [F5]the [Eb5]prejudice
[C5][G5]We must [Bb5]un-
learn [F5]the lies [Eb5]

[Verse 3]
[Db5]
I've
seen the calloused
I know the jaded
[Gb5]
I've
been disheartened
and I've lost control
But I
never crumbled in the
face of adversity
And I
always force myself
to believe

[Chorus]
[C5]  [G5]  [Bb5]
The [F5]foundation [Eb5]of our
[C5]lives [G5][Bb5]Built
on [F5]hollow [Eb5]ground
[C5][G5]We must [Bb5]un-
learn [F5]the [Eb5]prejudice
[C5][G5]We must [Bb5]un-
learn [F5]the lies [Eb5]

[Outro]
[C5]
Are you
willing to fight?
Are you
willing?
Take your life back
Fight
fight
Will you fight
to take your life back?
title: Hollow Ground
tuning: C G C F A D
